objective: Add JSON routes for start review, return for info, and decide. Each route calls the unchanged src/requests.js export and maps errors with the existing table.
why: The reconciliation finds ac1-2 partial because these three routes are missing. It finds ac1-3 partial because route tests for REVIEWER_AT_CAPACITY and NOT_ASSIGNED_REVIEWER are missing. The three exports already exist, so this slice does not wait for atlas-apex/khidma-live#20. Without these routes no request can reach UNDER_REVIEW, NEEDS_INFO, APPROVED, or REJECTED over HTTP. The citizen screen slice needs those states to prove ac2-1 and ac2-3. Basis: the reconciliation observed ec7d132. Later commits 6388ece and 6ceeb42 change only listRequestsByCitizen, which no o1 criterion depends on.

include: POST /requests/:id/start-review with a reviewerId body. It calls startReview.
POST /requests/:id/return with a reviewerId and note body. It calls returnForInfo.
POST /requests/:id/decide with a decision body of APPROVED or REJECTED. It calls decide.
One route test per new route in test/server.test.js.
Route tests that check status, code, and message for REVIEWER_AT_CAPACITY and NOT_ASSIGNED_REVIEWER.
A message check in the existing NOT_REQUEST_OWNER route test.
README route table updated with the three reviewer routes.
A route test for an invalid decision value on a request under review. It returns a 4xx with the module message.
exclude: The ac1-6 exports and any reviewer queue or load route. They wait for atlas-apex/khidma-live#20.
A reviewer check in decide. The decide body carries no reviewerId for now. The follow-up ticket that adds the check also adds reviewerId to the body.
Any HTML, CSS, or browser JavaScript. That is o2.
Host, Origin, and Content-Type checks. They ship with samahali/khidma-live#2.
